Who I Am

About Me

I'm Ahmed Safwat Kamal, a Software Engineer & Flutter Developer based in Cairo, Egypt, specializing in Flutter & Dart. I build cross-platform apps for iOS and Android that are fast, scalable, and user-friendly.

I recently completed my BSc in Computer Science & AI at Beni Suef University (2022–2026), and I've been building real-world apps since 2022 — from AI-powered recruitment platforms with real-time SignalR chat, to e-commerce apps, Islamic content apps, and budget trackers.

I work with Clean Architecture, BLoC/Cubit, Firebase, REST APIs, and Dependency Injection daily. I'm currently a Software Engineer / Flutter Developer at NOUBtech, contributing to production ERP systems and automated testing with Playwright, while continuing to build and ship my own Flutter apps.
